fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.34.2 keeps the v0.34.1 physical-furniture CumOverlays replay path but removes all ThreadInterface re-entry from OStim START/NODE callbacks, fixing the scene-start deadlock/freeze while preserving the same delayed free-scene RaceMenu/SKEE overlay materialization method.
